description:
Pause or resume an alert, change its events, email_mode or label, or rotate a webhook signing secret. Pass the id and only the fields to change.
Examples: {"id": "alr_3f9a...", "status": "paused"}. {"id": "alr_3f9a...", "status": "active"} resumes an alert paused after webhook failures. {"id": "alr_3f9a...", "rotate_secret": true} returns a new secret once; the old one stops working at once.
Returns {alert, secret?}.

events.description: What to be told about: "new_period" (a period not published before) and "revision" (a published value or its status changed). Default both.

id.description: Alert id from subscribe_alert or list_alerts, for example "alr_3f9a...".

rotate_secret.description: Webhook alerts only: issue a new signing secret.

name: update_alert
title: Change an alert
